title: Clinical trials snapshot and treatment ontology for post-viral and chronic conditions
description:
Snapshot of registered trials tracked by OSMF (registry fields from ClinicalTrials.gov), registry outcome measures for the tracked trials, and the OSMF treatment ontology that classifies trial interventions (drug, supplement, device, behavioural, comparator).

Registry content remains subject to ClinicalTrials.gov terms; cite the NCT number.

Live, daily-updated version: https://research.opensourcemed.info/trials/index.html. Built from commit 07f96ce4766e of the OSMF Research Tracker.

Research information, not medical advice.
